$notes: Every user-facing string in v1, keyed by screen. Loaded by the app as Localizable source; tests scan every value against data/denylist.json.

Register: technician's voice. States what was measured and what follows. No exclamation marks anywhere in the product. No 'your score is'. No softening preamble on low scores. Percentile is against the reference distribution, never against other users.

Rules-only scorer at launch: the score definition below is the smaller, honest claim (published norms), not the calibrated-panel claim in the original bible. Swap `methodology.what_the_score_is` when v1.1 ships the calibrated model.

The app name is {app_name} everywhere. The working name 'Mog' is itself on the denylist (comparative vocabulary), which is the naming tension the bible flagged. The copy deck stays name-agnostic until that is decided.
Copy review follows the clean-copy ladder (.agents/skills/clean-copy): first ask whether a string should exist at all. Empty string = the element is not rendered.

common.tier_subline: {tier_long} · roughly the {pct} percentile of the reference distribution
common.suppressed_low_confidence: Not measured. Retake in brighter, even light.
common.suppressed_occluded: Not measured. Something covered this area.

onboarding.start_body: One scan measures your face, scores it and builds a daily plan for the things you can change.
onboarding.goals_title: What do you want to work on?
onboarding.goals_body: Pick up to three, in order.
onboarding.about_body: Typical ranges differ by sex and age.
onboarding.time_title: How much time do you have each day?
onboarding.time_body: The plan is cut to fit.
onboarding.time_15_detail: Room for a daily habit or two.
onboarding.time_next_body: The scan takes a few seconds. You'll see what's kept before the camera opens.

consent.title: Before the camera opens
consent.body_1: To measure your face, the app reads its shape from the camera.
consent.point_policy: The biometric data policy has the full detail.
consent.affirm_label: I consent to {app_name} measuring my face on this device.
consent.decline_body: Nothing is captured. The app can't measure without this.
consent.state_block_title: Not available where you live yet
consent.state_block_body: Face measurement isn't offered in Illinois, Texas or Washington.
consent.p1_body: Images, depth data and landmarks are processed here and never uploaded.
consent.p2_title: Captures are deleted on the spot
consent.p2_body: Only measurements are kept: numbers like a canthal tilt of 4°.

capture.profile_hint_turn: Turn until only one eye is visible
capture.profile_hint_ear: We need to see your ear and the corner of your eye
capture.skip_profile_note: Profile measurements will show as needing a capture. You can add it later from Settings.
capture.camera_purpose: Measures your face on this phone. Camera images and depth data are never saved or sent.
capture.unsupported: Needs an iPhone with Face ID. Its TrueDepth camera supplies depth and head angle.
capture.camera_denied: Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings to scan.
capture.failed_body: Not enough could be measured. Retake in brighter, even light.
capture.intro: It captures on its own once all six checks pass.

processing.title: Measuring
processing.footnote: This runs on your iPhone and nothing is uploaded.

reveal.what_it_is: This is your starting point. About half of what makes a face appealing is personal taste, which no measurement captures.

results.title: Metrics
results.model_changed_title: The scoring model changed, so your score moved
results.model_changed_body: We updated the scoring model from {old} to {new} and re-scored your stored measurements on this phone. The measurements themselves are the same.
results.pro_body: See your number for each one and whether it's in the typical range.

metric_detail.reliability_B: Shown as a range: it moves more between sessions
metric_detail.reliability_C: Shown as a category: it moves too much between sessions for a number
metric_detail.fwhr_explainer: The community treats a higher ratio as desirable. A 2015 meta-analysis found the opposite. It carries no weight in the score.
metric_detail.community_explainer: No clinical norm exists. The range is the community's convention, and its score weight is near zero.
metric_detail.beard_note: Facial hair makes the jaw and chin harder to locate, so this band is wider.
metric_detail.schematic_note: A drawing of a generic face with your numbers on it.
metric_detail.geometry_note: Drawn from this capture's measurements. It isn't stored.

paywall.title: Unlock all {n} measurements
paywall.intro: {names} and {more} more are already measured. Pro shows your number for each one and whether it's in the typical range.
paywall.intro_plain: They're already measured. Pro shows your number for each one and whether it's in the typical range.
paywall.row_4: The typical range, and what each one means
paywall.renewal_terms: Renews until cancelled. Cancel any time in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.
paywall.failed: The purchase didn't go through. Try again.
paywall.no_store: Purchases work in the iPhone app.

today.title: Today
today.scan_open_body: Use the same light and time of day as last time if you can.
today.scan_locked_why: Skin and fat take weeks to change, and bone doesn't change at all.
today.quiet_checkin_body: If you're finding yourself checking this a lot, that's worth paying attention to. Appearance preoccupation is common and treatable. If it's weighing on you, talking to someone helps. 988 connects you to support any time.

streak.save_body: One repair a month covers a missed day. Completed weeks stay complete either way.
streak.save_unavailable_body: This month's repair is used. The streak restarts today. Completed weeks stay complete.
streak.repair_note: You get one a month and can't buy more.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.intro: Built from your scan and ordered by how strong the research is.
plan.professional_footer: We don't recommend procedures or prescriptions and we have no financial relationship with any provider.

journey.title: The path
journey.intro: 5 of 7 days completes a week. Scans at weeks 4 and 8.
journey.finish_body: Both scans are done. The plan rebuilds from the week-8 scan.

progress.title: Progress
progress.model_note: Scores are only comparable across scans on the same model version. A change marked with a version came from a model update.
progress.empty_body: Your first comparison comes with the week-4 scan.

share.title: Share
share.photo_warning: Your capture leaves the device only if you choose to include it, and only in the image you share.

methodology.title: How the score works
methodology.frames_body: Each scan takes ten frames and keeps the middle value, so one odd frame doesn't change your result.
methodology.range_body: Each measurement is placed against the published range for your sex and age. Measurements with stronger research count for more.
methodology.band_body: Scan again and your score lands somewhere in this band. It comes from how much your measurements move between frames and between scans.
methodology.what_it_is_not: The score doesn't measure attractiveness. About half of what makes a face appealing is personal taste, and you're never compared with other users.

settings.title: You
settings.consent_revoke_body: The app stops measuring. Your existing measurements stay until you delete them.
settings.delete_body: This wipes every measurement, plan and setting from this phone, and it can't be undone.

day_done.title: Day {day}
day_done.note: Your streak counts the days you did the plan.
